## Objective
Reimplement the Java Swing app (animated gradient, bokeh circles, pulsing greeting, "Click me" button cycling greetings) in TypeScript. The GUI becomes an HTML canvas page; `--text` becomes a Node CLI. Behaviour and constants match the Java source.

## Interface
Files:
- `package.json`: `"type": "module"`, scripts `build` = `tsc -p tsconfig.json`, `start` = `node dist/cli.js`; devDependencies typescript ^5 and @types/node ^20; no runtime deps.
- `tsconfig.json`: target ES2022, module NodeNext, moduleResolution NodeNext, lib [ES2022, DOM], types [node], strict true, rootDir `src`, outDir `dist`, include `src`.
- `.gitignore`: `node_modules`, `dist`.
- `index.html`: a `<canvas id="canvas">` filling the window, a subtitle element and a `<button id="greet">Click me</button>` positioned at bottom centre (white translucent rounded style, as in FancyFrame), and `<script type="module" src="dist/main.js">`.
- `src/gradientPanel.ts` exports:
  `export class GradientPanel { constructor(random?: () => number); start(): void; stop(): void; setGreeting(greeting: string): void; tick(dtMs: number): void; draw(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, w: number, h: number): void; }`
- `src/main.ts`: browser entry; no exports. Uses `GradientPanel`, `requestAnimationFrame`, and a `GREETINGS` array identical to the Java one.
- `src/cli.ts`: Node entry. With `--text` argument prints `Hello, World!` and exits 0. Without it prints a short message saying to open `index.html` in a browser (after `npm run build`) and exits 0.
Relative imports must use the `.js` extension (e.g. `./gradientPanel.js`).

## Behavior
1. Constants and math follow `GradientPanel.java`: FRAME_MS 30, 14 bokeh circles with random position/radius/velocity as in the constructor, HUE_SPEED 0.0008 and PULSE_SPEED 0.004 scaled by elapsed ms, wrap-around for bokeh positions.
2. `draw` paints: linear gradient from top-left (hue, s 0.55, b 0.95) to bottom-right (hue+0.5, s 0.65, b 0.55); bokeh circles with fill alpha ≈ 60/255 and 1.5px stroke alpha ≈ 110/255; centred greeting with a pulse scale 0.92 + 0.12*pulse, font size max(16, min(w/12, h/5)) bold sans-serif, black shadow offset 4px, white text alpha (200 + 55*pulse)/255. Implement HSB→RGB conversion in a small private helper.
3. `main.ts` sizes the canvas to the window (respecting devicePixelRatio, resized on `resize`), runs a requestAnimationFrame loop calling `tick(elapsed)` and `draw`, and the button cycles `GREETINGS` calling `setGreeting`. Greetings: "Hello, World!", "Hola, Mundo!", "Bonjour, le monde !", "Hallo, Welt!", "Ciao, Mondo!", "こんにちは、世界！". Set `document.title` to "Hello, World!".
4. `start`/`stop` toggle whether `tick` advances state (stopped means `tick` is a no-op).
5. `cli.ts` and `gradientPanel.ts` must not touch DOM globals at import time, so the CLI runs in plain Node.

## Invariants
Strict TypeScript with no `any`. The Java sources stay untouched in this task.

## Edge cases
Large `dtMs` (tab backgrounded): clamp it to 100 before use. Bokeh wrap must keep values within [0,1].

## Guardrails
Do not edit or delete anything under `src/*.java`. Do not add runtime dependencies or a bundler. Do not commit `dist` or `node_modules`. Do not write tests.

## Out of scope
Deleting the Java files (T2), tests, packaging or deployment.
